help.title: Email Studio — Guide
help.overview.title: What is the Email Studio?
help.overview.text: The Email Studio is the central building block for all email templates in the ABpE Portal. All apps (cv_extractor, ingest_email, matching) send emails exclusively via this central API.
help.overview.modes.title: Sender Modes
help.overview.user.title: USER — Personal
help.overview.user.text: From address = logged-in user. Each employee sends with their own email and signature. Angelo sends as angelo@abcona.de, Tanja as tg@abcona.de.
help.overview.template.title: TEMPLATE — Fixed
help.overview.template.text: From address = fixed configured address (e.g. info@abcona.de). Signature stored in the template. For newsletters, general info emails.
help.overview.auto.title: AUTO — Machine
help.overview.auto.text: From = noreply@abcona.de. No signature. X-Auto-Response-Suppress header set. For system emails (upload confirmation, pipeline status).
help.overview.api.title: Central API
help.overview.api.text: Other apps never send directly via SMTP — always via EmailStudio.send():
help.modules.title: Modules — Reusable Blocks
help.modules.text: Modules are HTML building blocks that can be inserted into any template. Syntax: {{block:identifier}}
help.modules.available.title: Available Modules
help.modules.howto.title: How to use modules:
help.modules.howto.step1: 1. In the editor, click the 'Modules' tab
help.modules.howto.step2: 2. Click the desired module → it will be inserted at the cursor position
help.modules.howto.step3: 3. The module appears as {{block:name}} in the HTML
help.modules.howto.step4: 4. When saving/sending, the block is automatically resolved

help.vars.title: Variables
help.vars.text: Variables are replaced with actual values when sending. Syntax: {variable_name}
help.vars.context.title: Context Variables (blue)
help.vars.user.title: User Variables (green)
help.vars.system.title: System Variables (gray)
help.translate.title: Translations
